c1cc9dbf05fb99f6ac1a65af397d8b4c8a118893.sourceText: MID360 的雷达与内部 IMU 装在同一台设备里，整机倾斜安装、底盘转动和云台 yaw 转动都不会改变两者之间的固定关系。整台雷达在车上如何安装、随哪个关节转动，由机器人 TF描述，不能靠开启这项替代。
c1cc9dbf05fb99f6ac1a65af397d8b4c8a118893.translatedText: The MID360's lidar and internal IMU are housed in the same device; tilting the entire unit, rotating the chassis, and rotating the gimbal yaw will not change the fixed relationship between the two\. How the entire lidar is mounted on the vehicle and which joint it rotates with are described by the robot TF and cannot be replaced by enabling this option\.
